decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - That this consent for a limited period of five years expiring on 1st March 2010.

Condition : 2 - All advertisements displays, and any site used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition.
Condition : 4 - Where any advertisement is required under these regulations to be removed, the removal shall be carried out to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant planning permission.

Condition : 6 - No advertisment shall be sited or displayed so as to obscure, or hinder, the ready interpretation of any road sign, railway sign or aid to navigation by water or air so as to otherwise render hazardous the use of any highway, railway, waterway ( including any coastal waters) or aerodrome (civil or military).

Condition : 7 - It is considered that this application for the banner sign would not have a significant adverse upon adjoining residential occupiers, and will be in keeping with the area.  On balance, the development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and ENV-1.5 (Advertisements) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
description: Erection of 1 x PVC banner to rear of building non-illuminated
